summary: iptables options: tcp_flags dict, DNAT to_destination, to_ports, SNAT to_source, uid_owner with negation, and wait for the xtables lock.
questions: How do I do DNAT with the iptables module?
How do I redirect to another port?
How do I match packets from a specific user?
How do I wait for the xtables lock?

answer_card.title: iptables NAT, owner, tcp_flags
answer_card.answer_md:
- `to_destination` (DNAT), `to_source` (SNAT), `to_ports` (redirect/ports; tcp/udp/dccp/sctp)
- `tcp_flags`: `{flags: ALL, flags_set: [ACK, SYN]}`
- `uid_owner`: UID/user; `!` = all except
- `wait`: seconds to wait for xtables lock
